dcterms:description: AnaLog is a natural language inference dataset designed to test language models' abilities to perform deductive and analytical reasoning. It contains 24,000 items, each consisting of a premise, a hypothesis, and their logical relation (entailment or non-entailment). The dataset is constructed using templates and a carefully selected vocabulary to ensure a balanced distribution of logical connectives and reasoning categories.
